name: awesome-claude-skills
description: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools for customizing Claude AI workflows
one_liner: A big curated bookmark list of add-ons for Claude AI, organized so people can find useful ones without searching from scratch.
buyer: Nobody pays directly for a link list, though it's a discovery channel — a tool maker whose skill gets featured here gains free exposure to Claude power users.
business_use_cases: A skill developer submits their tool to the list to get discovered by the Claude power-user community for free.
A newsletter curator mines the list weekly to find fresh content for an 'AI tools roundup' publication.
An agency skims it to find pre-built skills instead of building custom automations from scratch, saving billable hours.

money_ideas.idea: Turn the list into a searchable directory site with sponsored/featured placements for skill vendors.
Curate a paid weekly digest highlighting the best new entries for busy AI practitioners.

steal_this: This weekend, scrape the list into a simple searchable web directory with tags and a 'submit your skill' form, then sell featured listing slots to skill authors.
